description: Check a code from verify_start. Give to (checks the newest code sent there) or id, and code. Returns valid true or false and a status: approved, wrong_code, expired, too_many_attempts (5 wrong codes lock it), already_used, replaced or not_found. A right code works once. Uses no allowance.

to.description: The address the code was sent to.

name: verify_check
title: Check a verification code
